parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. The value must be a positive integer that does not exceed the maximum value of the INTEGER data type. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Valid values: ***30***, **50**, and **100**. Default value: **30**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region where the instance resides. > You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~196841~~) operation to query the regions supported by PolarDB-X, including region IDs.

parameters.name: SlinkTaskId
parameters.description: The ID of the target task.
